title: Wiki note: multi-modal earnings day prediction (arXiv:2605.25894)
rationale: arXiv:2605.25894 (May 2026, Sharpe not reported) combines 15 fundamental features + 3 TA indicators + FinBERT sentiment in a Transformer architecture to predict stock direction on earnings announcement days. Transformer outperforms LSTM in the ablation study. Relevance 7/10: the multi-modal fusion approach (fundamentals + TA + NLP) is a natural evolution of H174 and could inform H177 design. No Sharpe reported — not backtest-ready, but worth recording in the event-driven wiki page as a 'next-generation architecture' reference for when H174/H177 warrant an upgrade.
